verified: Rest of World reports that researchers at a small Accra-based AI lab removed the guardrails on their own drug-discovery model in 2024 and prompted it to design toxins.
unconfirmed: what the model output, whether any toxin designs were viable or ordered, whether the experiment was peer-reviewed or documented in a paper, and the lab's own public statement — the excerpt is a short profile rather than a technical report, and the lab is named in the article's web address rather than in the supplied text.

verified: Rest of World 报道了加纳阿克拉实验室在 2024 年移除药物发现模型防护栏并要求其设计毒素，报道将此事与 DNA 合成监管缺口相连。
unconfirmed: 模型是否真的生成可操作毒素设计、涉及哪些毒素、防护栏的具体形式，以及实验室是否公开完整结果；提供的摘录未说明这些细节。

titles.en: Ghana lab strips guardrails from drug-discovery AI to probe bioweapon risk
